description.en: Three figures that test whether the engine can carry a physics course.
description.zh: 三张图，测试引擎能否撑起一门物理课。

description.en: A pendulum, point charges and a torque, as the engine draws them.
description.zh: 单摆、点电荷和力矩，用引擎画出来的样子。

text.en: The bob is let go at an angle; its swing is computed step by step from θ″ = −(g/L) sin θ, beside the small-angle model θ″ = −(g/L) θ (dashed).
text.zh: 摆锤从某个角度松手；它的摆动按 θ″ = −(g/L) sin θ 一步一步算出来，旁边虚线是小角度模型 θ″ = −(g/L) θ。

caption.en: A 1 m pendulum released at 120°. A simulation (velocity Verlet, 240 steps a second).
caption.zh: 1 米长的单摆，从 120° 松手。数值模拟（速度 Verlet，每秒 240 步）。

text.en: At 20° the two stay together; at 170° the real one takes more than twice as long, which the exposures show: close together near the top, where it is slow.
text.zh: 20° 时两者几乎重合；170° 时真实的单摆要花两倍多的时间，频闪也看得出来：在顶端附近慢，影子挤在一起。

caption.en: Released at 170°, with exposures every 0.1 s.
caption.zh: 从 170° 松手，每 0.1 秒拍一张。

text.en: The potential as a tint (red positive, blue negative) with its equipotentials, the field as arrows and as lines traced through it, as many from a charge as its size.
text.zh: 电势用底色表示（红正蓝负），配上等势线；电场既画成箭头，也画成沿电场追踪出的电场线，从每个电荷出发的条数和它的电量成正比。

text.en: A lever about a pivot, a force at a point of it, and τ = r × F along the axis it would turn the lever about.
text.zh: 绕支点转动的杠杆，作用在杠杆上某一点的力，以及沿着杠杆转轴方向的力矩 τ = r × F。

caption.en: Turn the view; the force and where it acts move by hand.
caption.zh: 可以转动视角；力和作用点都能用手移动。
